# DeepSpot2Cell

> DeepSpot2Cell predicts virtual single-cell spatial transcriptomics from H&E histopathology images using only spot-level supervision. It extends DeepSpot to single-cell resolution by leveraging cell segmentation masks during inference.

## Key Facts

- Predicts single-cell gene expression from H&E images without requiring single-cell spatial transcriptomics training data
- Uses spot-level supervision (Visium) to train, then infers at single-cell resolution
- Integrates cell tile, spot tile, and neighboring spot context via pathology foundation models
- Presented at NeurIPS 2025 Imageomics
- Compatible with pathology foundation models: UNI, H-optimus-0, Phikon v2
- MIT licensed, Python 3.9+, PyTorch Lightning-based

## When to Use DeepSpot2Cell

- You want single-cell resolution spatial transcriptomics predictions but only have spot-level training data (Visium)
- You have H&E images with cell segmentation and want to predict per-cell gene expression
- You want to go beyond spot-level resolution without needing expensive single-cell spatial transcriptomics experiments

## Related Projects

- [DeepSpot](https://github.com/ratschlab/DeepSpot): Predicts spatial transcriptomics at spot-level (Visium) and single-cell (Xenium) resolution from H&E images
- [AESTETIK](https://github.com/ratschlab/aestetik): Autoencoder for learning multi-modal spatial transcriptomics representations

## Links

- Repository: https://github.com/ratschlab/DeepSpot2Cell
- Preprint: https://www.biorxiv.org/content/10.1101/2025.09.23.678121v1
- HEST-1k Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/MahmoodLab/hest

## Installation

```bash
conda env create -f environment.yaml
conda activate deepspot2cell
pip install -e .
```

## Citation

Nonchev, K., Manaiev, G., Koelzer, V.H. and Rätsch, G. (2025). DeepSpot2Cell: Predicting Virtual Single-Cell Spatial Transcriptomics from H&E images using Spot-Level Supervision. bioRxiv. DOI: 10.1101/2025.09.23.678121
